list.caption: Projects: number, client, step, documents, due date, owner

all.title: No projects yet
all.text: A project appears when a client accepts a quote: then the contract, invoices and act open up. No quotes have been accepted yet.

filtered.title: No projects match the filters
filtered.text: Remove some filters or change the search.

card.title: Project {{number}}
card.doneNote: The project is completed: the act is accepted and all invoices are paid.
card.doneRule: The project becomes “Completed” when the act is accepted and all invoices are paid.

documents.title: Project documents
documents.invoiceMissingSigned: The contract is signed, no invoice yet: issue it in “Finance”.
documents.createContractLabel: Create a contract draft from the quote
documents.issueActLabel: Issue the act for the project
documents.paymentsLater: Issuing and payment live in “Finance” (the section is connected separately)
documents.invoiceHint: Issuing and confirming payment are in “Finance”.

lineStatus.in_transit: On the way to the client

delivery.failed: Could not save the mark. Please try again.

dialog.in_transit: Sent to the client, in transit
dialog.dateInvalid: Date must be today or earlier and not before dispatch
dialog.fileHint: Signed waybill or photo, up to 20 MB. Optional

consequence.in_transit: The client will see in the portal that the delivery is in transit.
consequence.delivered: The client will see “Delivered” and can accept the delivery or report issues.

contract.sent_to_client: Contract draft sent to the client for agreement
contract.client_agreed: Contract wording agreed by the client
contract.scan_attached: Scan of the signed contract attached
contract.remark_countered: Reply to the counterparty: our edition

act.scan_attached: Scan of the signed act attached

project.delivery_in_transit: Sent to the client, in transit

state.project: The draft has not been sent to the client yet.
state.atClient: The contract is with the counterparty. Waiting for the answer: “Accept the edition” or “I have remarks”.
state.client_agreed: The edition is agreed. The contract awaits signing: mark it below once signed.
state.issued_at_operator: The contract awaits signing: mark it below once signed.
state.rejected: The client rejected the contract. Fix the draft and send it for agreement again.

reject.title: The client rejected the contract

reason.label: Reason for rejection
reason.hint: Required: as told by the client, it goes to the log.

reject.disabled: The button becomes available when you write a reason.

scan.label: Scan of the signed contract
scan.hint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 20 MB.
scan.choose: Choose a scan file — the button becomes available.

done.client_agreed: Marked: the client agreed the wording.
done.mark_issued: Marked: the contract is issued for signature.
done.attach_scan: The contract is signed, the scan is stored.
done.sign_ours: The contract is signed for the company.
done.request_deviation: The request went to the Legal holder.

template.title: Contract from a template
template.line: “{{name}}”, ed. {{edition}} · requisites, sum and specification from the quote
template.visas: A contract with a deviation follows the visa route and does not go to the client before it.

blocker.CONTRACT_NEEDS_OUR_SIGNATURE: It goes to the client after our signature.
blocker.CONTRACT_DEVIATION_PENDING: It does not go to the client until the Legal holder decides on the deviation.

ask.title: Deviation request
ask.label: Clause and reason
ask.hint: The request goes to the Legal holder.

done.sign_ours: The contract is signed for the company.
done.request_deviation: The request went to the Legal holder.

blocker.visas_not_requested: Visas are needed. Press “Send for signature”: once they are collected, the contract can go to the client.
blocker.visas_declined: The contract was not accepted for visas. Send it for signature again.
blocker.visas_returned: Visas returned: {{roles}}. Fix the contract and send it for signature again.
blocker.no_visa_holder: Nobody can give the visa: {{roles}}. Assign the role to an employee.
blocker.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to assign the role: {{roles}}.

term.title: Contract term
term.renewsHint: You can decline the renewal until {{notice}}.

declined.company: We declined the renewal: the contract ends on time.
declined.client: The counterparty declined the renewal: the contract ends on time.

term.foreign: Foreign counterparty: renewed by a supplementary agreement.
term.editionNewer: Signed on edition {{edition}}; edition {{newer}} is available. Until the counterparty signs it, renewal stays on the old one.
term.nda: Confidentiality after the contract ends: {{years}} years.
term.declineConfirm: The contract ends on {{until}} and will not renew. If you change your mind, use «Restore renewal» on this card.

sign.title: Awaiting signature
sign.hint: Once both sides have signed, mark it here — a scan or a note is enough.
sign.noteHint: Where and when it was signed, where the original is.
sign.term: The contract term is counted when you mark it.

remark.title: Counterparty remarks
remark.noCompare: A file is attached. Comparison not done: the document is too large or cannot be parsed — open the file.

decide.counterLabel: What we reply to the counterparty
decide.counterHint: The counterparty will see the reply in their account.
decide.nobody: No one holds the deciding vote: grant an employee the right to sign contracts in the employee card ("Employees") — they will close the remarks.

remark.next: When everyone has answered and agrees, the counterparty edition is accepted by itself. The deciding vote can close the remarks at any time.

none.title: No act yet
none.noInvoice: No invoice issued yet — issue it in “Finance”.
none.notDelivered: The act comes after delivery: it can be issued once the goods are delivered to the client.
none.ready: The invoice is issued: you can issue the act.

state.issued: The act is with the client for acceptance. When they sign, attach the scan.
state.signed: The act is signed, the scan is stored.
state.accepted: The client accepted the act in the account. No scan.
state.returned: The client returned the act with a reason. Fix it and issue it again.

return.title: The customer returned the act

reason.label: Reason for return
reason.hint: Required: as told by the customer, it goes to the log and to the issuer.

return.disabled: The button becomes available when you write a reason.

scan.label: Scan of the signed act
scan.hint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 20 MB.
scan.choose: Choose a scan file — the button becomes available.

files.tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB.
files.wrongType: A PDF or an image is needed: JPG, PNG, WEBP.
files.generating: The file is still being prepared. Try again in a few seconds.

errors.contract_transition_not_allowed: The contract is already in another status. Refresh the page.
errors.act_sign_not_allowed: The act is already in another status. Refresh the page.
errors.not_issued: Issue the document first: a draft has no number.
errors.already_requested: The document is already out for signing.
errors.already_signed: The document is already signed. A correction is a new document.
errors.document_closed: The document is cancelled: there is nothing to sign.
errors.no_crm_user: Your account is not linked to a staff profile yet: signing cannot be requested.
errors.act_already_exists: The project already has an act.
errors.not_delivered: The act is issued after delivery: the goods are not delivered yet.
errors.goods_not_shipped: The goods are not shipped from the warehouse yet: delivery marks are available after shipping.
errors.no_invoice: The act is issued against an issued invoice: there is none yet.
errors.contract_exists: The contract draft is already created.
errors.scan_invalid: The file does not look like a scan: a PDF or an image up to 20 MB is needed.
errors.forbidden: You lack the capability for this action. It is granted by those who manage employees; see Profile, “My capabilities”.
errors.unavailable: The data did not load. Try again later.
errors.payload: The file is larger than 20 MB.
errors.unknown: It did not work. Try again.
errors.contract_needs_our_signature: Sign the contract for the company first.
errors.contract_already_sent: The contract is already with the client. Refresh the page.
errors.contract_deviations_disabled: Deviations from the template are off in settings.
errors.deviation_not_requested: There is no request any more. Refresh the page.
errors.contract_template_unfilled: The contract has unfilled template places.
errors.contract_visas_required: Visas are needed first. Refresh the page.

loadError.title: Could not load
loadError.text: Check the connection and try again.

notFound.title: Project not found
notFound.text: There is no such project, or it is not open yet: a project appears when the client accepts the quote.
